newsitem.title: USA: Farmland restarts Kansas cracker, sets new work.
newsitem.headline: Farmland restarts Kansas cracker, sets new work.

text.p: Farmland Industries Inc restarted the 28,000 barrel per day (bpd) catalytic cracker at its Coffeyville, Kansas refinery on Wednesday but will start work at another unit within 10 days, a company official said.
The company will take a 16,000 bpd reformer unit into turnaround on February 22, according to the official. Two distillate hydrotreaters with capacity totalling 27,000 bpd will be taken down as well.
The restarted cracker was taken down January 28 for unscheduled maintenance and originally expected to restart by February 7.
((-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1626))
